comment: Scenario for platformer-tsrun.mjs / platformer-zesarux.py / platformer-fuse.sh / platformer-compare.mjs. Ticks are V_TICKS (ticks completed): the key state for tick N is the one the game's FRAME(N) reads, i.e. it is set when V_TICKS becomes N and held until it becomes N+1. Keys: keyboard rows as the runtime reads them (row index = half-row, bit 0..4); 'key' names are the game's KEYDOWN letters.

keys.name: SPACE
keys.why: start the game from the title (fire edge)

keys.name: P
keys.why: walk right; the camera scrolls once the hero passes x=72

keys.name: Q
keys.why: jump (Q is read every other tick)
